images.name: cover-harbor
images.prompt: Bold vintage riso-screenprint podcast cover. Duotone palette: deep petrol teal (#01516a) and warm apricot/peach (#fcc5a3) with cream highlights. A stylized northern-German Baltic Sea harbor at golden hour — a lighthouse, gentle waves, two cheeky seagulls chatting at a vintage ribbon microphone, a small sailboat on the horizon. Thick confident flat shapes, grain texture, playful warm comedy mood, clean negative space in the top third. No text, no letters, no watermark. Square.
